verdict.rationale: Folk documents a versioned REST API covering core CRM records: people with create, update and delete, groups, custom objects including Deals, custom fields, enrichment, batch operations, and standard-spec webhooks. It does not evidence that the API matches everything available in the UI. Many UI features (email campaigns and sequences, dashboards, Gmail/LinkedIn sync, AI-generated fields, workspace roles) have no documented API counterpart, there is no parity claim, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API coverage of email campaigns/sequences, dashboards, integrations and workspace settings, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
